hooks.text: 在弹幕潮中寻找射击窗口，同时守住基地核心，融合塔防布阵与主动射击。
hooks.excerpt: Enemies swarm like tidal waves. You must choose skills wisely, find your firing window amidst the bullet chaos, and never forget to defend your base core.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 枪械、火、冰、雷与能量天赋可叠加触发连锁反应，并针对敌人组合克制流派。
hooks.excerpt: The game offers multiple talent paths: Gunslinging DPS, Fire, Ice, Lightning, Energy — each can stack and trigger chain reactions with one another. Craft your own Fire-Lightning Storm, Ice Explosion, Machine Gun Physical DPS build… different builds, completely different experiences!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 灵体伙伴、不同弹道手感的枪械与专属天赋英雄共同决定开局和中期转型。
hooks.excerpt: Fantom – A spirit unit that fights alongside you, providing passive bonuses and an active skill. Gun System – Different weapon types offer unique bullet patterns and handling. Multiple Characters – Each with their own unique talent skill, affecting your early-game strategy and mid-game transitions.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
